calibration.boundary: Unchanged real main.cpp and MidiDevice.cpp with substituted test-only RtMidi API; synchronous callback offers at native API boundaries, real SDL dummy callbacks. No physical CoreMIDI driver, hardware timing or OS fault-injection claim.

material.criterion: Exact full/clipped literal RGBA plates and exact changed-pixel set only at individually identified boundary-crossing glyph rectangles; full/cut pixels outside them must remain identical, including complete glyphs/nontext/focus. Surviving and hidden focus required. No whole-textbox exclusion or numeric pixel tolerance. Final literal_mismatches sums pixel and difference-set mismatches.

rtmidi.boundary: Locked zero-initialization of two CoreMidiData allocations in the prepared build copy; does not establish physical connection/close, OS-driver failure, hotplug or asynchronous-driver safety.

installed.private_calibration_evidence_boundary: These assertions are in the exact source of the executed eight-method test; the method's private diagnostics are not printed or separately downloaded.

historical_boundary: The prior b9 install/Windows fixture failures and d556 GCC13 native-sanitizer build failure retain their original source-specific outcomes. This new macOS d8 execution neither rewrites them nor independently audits the Linux sanitizer/R4 or VST3 jobs.
limits: No macOS sanitizer result from these Release jobs.
Backend fault/quarantine tests use fake RtMidi; quarantine's ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 is a named existing test setting, not blanket leak qualification.
Native Cocoa/CoreAudio and CoreMIDI are compiled and metadata-checked; runtime acceptance here uses dummy SDL and no physical MIDI port.
No physical hardware/hotplug/OS fault, real display or Retina/DPI journey, screen-reader semantics, DAW, callback-deadline, signed/notarized distribution or literal 1:1 reference equality claim.
This exact-source result does not qualify later A46/A48 source/workflow edits or final session closure.
next_gate: Integrator accepts this audit and the separate Linux/Windows/VST3 audits, then qualifies the actual next publication. M9 physical macOS acceptance must exercise the relocated exact installed build on an identified Cocoa/CoreAudio display/controller/device with real port callbacks, calibration/change/reconnect/fault journeys, held-note/focus/resize/release evidence and numeric exit status; preserve the dummy/fake boundaries.
